title: Inverse Compilation of Strongly Connected Component Completions in Relational Causal Schemas
banked_reason: The sound same-terminal-attribute and inverse-compilation results remain letter-scale because the deliberately unfiltered single-perspective cover problem has no verified consequence for a valid relational representation, ground semantics, separation, or discovery procedure.
gap_reasons: tier=letter below novelty_target=field: the deliberately unfiltered, single-perspective, collateral-edge-tolerant cover problem has no verified consequence for a valid relational representation, ground semantics, separation, or discovery procedure.

The general same-terminal-attribute theorem is supportable, but even a correct implementation is an immediate syntactic class-acyclic non-realizability result for the deliberately unfiltered target and remains letter-scale; a field result requires the excluded multi-perspective semantic transfer.
Pivot rather than advance: no repair within the present unfiltered ordinary-edge question supplies the field-tier causal consequence required by novelty_target.
proof_attempt_summary: Three proposal revisions developed an exact inverse compiler and checkable coverability certificates for the unfiltered ordered full-SCC target, with fixed-model 2H and 4H lower bounds plus class-acyclic and exact-realization obstructions. A validity-gate-authorized final reframe generalized the same-terminal-attribute self-loop obstruction, but fresh review still placed it at letter tier because it has no proved multi-perspective ground, separation, or discovery consequence. Future work should reuse the compiler and witnesses but must build that semantic transfer as a new theorem graph rather than infer it from single-perspective ordinary-edge coverage.
tldr: The project asks for the optimal canonical inverse compilation of an unfiltered ordered full-SCC completion target on a fixed schema, perspective, and radius-limited ordinary-variable universe. It proposes an output-sensitive compiler that returns the target, its exact minimax hop cost, the canonical family of unique minimum-hop inverse supports, and an independently checkable positive or negative H-bounded coverability certificate. A common-prefix anchored class gives a nontrivial positive boundary, while fixed models attain exact regenerated costs 2H and 4H for every H. Class-acyclic and palindrome results are stronger diagnostics only: the contribution allows collateral ordinary edges and claims no exact AGG, ground-abstraction, separation, RCD, relational-acyclification, or RelFCI transfer.
gap: Published relational work defines forward extension and several lifted causal-discovery representations, but the inspected sources do not solve the inverse optimization problem induced by unfiltered full-SCC ordinary-edge completion: compute the least canonical hop budget, synthesize an optimal family, and certify both yes and no instances. The original and revised AGG limitations of Lee and Honavar rule out interpreting an ordinary-edge cover as a separation or discovery theorem.
fill: Establish the inverse-support lemma; give the optimal output-sensitive compiler and verifier; characterize success by prefix spread with an anchored positive family; and demonstrate exact 2H and sharp 4H regenerated costs, while separately diagnosing class-acyclic and exact ordinary-edge nonrepresentability.
